answer: Treat each key like a coral reef: rewards accrete in escrow for 30 epochs before vesting. Every epoch 2% of keys get a deep audit (funding trace, timing, writing style). If an audited key is linked to others, the whole cluster's escrow is clawed back. A farm of N keys faces a 1-0.98^N chance of losing everything each epoch, so a 50-key plume is nearly certain to be caught within a few epochs, while one honest key on its own mesa rarely risks anything.
